# Rapidfire — G4 Wonderbolt

Rapidfire is the male pegasus Wonderbolt whom Fancy Pants expects to win the Canterlot Wonderbolts Derby. Rarity backs Fleetfoot instead, making his name memorable even though the episode never clearly identifies which racer he is. He is a named character in *Friendship Is Magic*, not a fandom-invented pony. [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Sweet_and_Elite).

- **Name and history:** “Rapidfire” is spoken in *Sweet and Elite* (2011) and appears on the team roster in the officially published *The Elements of Harmony* guidebook. Some unofficial transcripts render it “Rapid Fire”; this is a spelling variation, not a separate identity. [Wonderbolts guidebook discussion](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Wonderbolts); [alternate transcription](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=63915).
- **Appearance:** His individual coat, mane, eyes, and cutie mark have *not* been reliably established. The Wonderbolts typically wear blue flight suits with yellow lightning motifs and goggles, but that is a team look, not a verified Rapidfire portrait. A contemporary production-layout comment attributed to Nayuki explicitly said Rapidfire was unspecified, while the white-maned mare was Fleetfoot. [Production comment quoted in the Wonderbolts article](https://mlp.fandom.com/pt/wiki/Os_Wonderbolts).
- **Voice and appearances:** Rapidfire has no identified spoken dialogue or credited voice actor. His verifiable television appearance is as a *name mentioned* in *Sweet and Elite* (S2E9), rather than an individually confirmed on-screen design; later onscreen, film, or comic appearances are not established by the sources checked. [Wonderbolts character listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Wonderbolts).

## Important moments

1. **Fancy Pants's favorite — “Sweet and Elite” (S2E9).** At the Derby, Fancy Pants enthusiastically predicts Rapidfire will take the prize, establishing his reputation among Canterlot spectators. [Full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mCpT_PTia18) (scene timestamp unavailable).
2. **Fleetfoot's upset — “Sweet and Elite” (S2E9).** Rarity predicts Fleetfoot instead, and Fleetfoot wins by a nose; this is the outcome attached to Rapidfire's name, though his own finishing position is not individually identified. [Episode guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sweet_and_Elite) (scene timestamp unavailable).
